== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Dream aura is a specialized form of energy typically characterized by violet or purple hues, though it can manifest as various colors depending on its composition. It is frequently associated with the mind and consciousness, capable of producing illusions, phantom images, sounds, and even intense feelings like terror or fear. In certain environments, such as the [[Dream Well]], it can exist in harmony with other elements like [[water aura]]. This energy plays a significant role in the creation and function of various entities and objects. It is used to power [[dream constructs]], fuel certain techniques like the [[Fox Dream]], and serves as the foundation for [[Sylvan Dreamseeds]]—spirits born under its influence. It is also linked to [[dream tablets]], which act as repositories for knowledge and memories. Some beings, such as the spirit [[Dross]], utilize dream aura to function or manifest. Furthermore, certain powerful entities or parasitic techniques can siphon excess dream aura from hosts. While it is often used for mental manipulation or distraction, highly concentrated or corrupted forms of dream aura can be dangerous, affecting perception and even causing physical or mental distress.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Timaias Adama|Adama]] cultivates dream aura, which serves as a fundamental source of power. This energy is capable of dancing around a person's head and provides the necessary fuel for [[Dross]] to function. While [[Kenvata Nasuma Juvari|Juvari]] is able to weave dream aura, its presence can also be used to instill fear in individuals like [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]].}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|[[Lindon]] utilized dream aura to stimulate specific sections of [[Dross]]'s structure. While [[Dross]] observed that certain images within a room were not composed of dream aura, the substance was capable of weaving through the [[Hollow Domain]]. [[Yerin]] employed the energy to shield herself against voices within her mind, and it was noted that dream aura remains thick in any city. Additionally, a small trickle of the aura flowed into [[Mercy]]'s mind.}}
